Initial release — AI-powered video creation tool for financial planners and advisors.

- Generates marketing and educational videos for wealth management, financial planning, and horse carriage tour businesses.
- Supports content types such as fiduciary/fee transparency explainers, retirement readiness frameworks, Social Security and Medicare strategy videos, and more.
- Designed to differentiate advisors, build trust, and convert prospective clients via explainer and testimonial video content.
- Targeted for solo advisors, independent practices, fee-only planners, and firms serving pre-retirees, inheritors, business owners, and young professionals.
- Includes scenarios and use cases for client onboarding, retention, and local search optimization.
